Version 0.3.2 completes the coordinated release of the Lit design system, React wrappers, browser distribution, Devtools and documentation MCP.

Browser delivery selects production dependency variants. The website, selective modules, complete bundles and copied table builds use explicit production settings. The unminified bundle retains readable output and CSS debugging maps. Declaration generation sorts source roots for reproducible output. The documentation MCP uses upstream security fixes in SDK 1.32.0, Hono 4.13.13 and its node adapter 2.1.5.

- [React](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@acmelabs/design-system-react/v/0.3.2)
- [Browser](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@acmelabs/design-system-browser/v/0.3.2)
- [Devtools](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@acmelabs/design-system-devtools/v/0.3.2)
- [MCP](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@acmelabs/design-system-mcp/v/0.3.2)

Download `published-release-0.3.2.zip` with `release-v0.3.2-SHA256SUMS.txt`. It contains the exact public npm archives, release record and verified public provenance.

Release checks cover Linux builds, strict types, unit tests, dependency audit, archive integrity, package consumers and Chromium/Firefox/WebKit behavior. Production navigation and all six browser delivery entries reject console warnings. Public CDN and documentation checks verify delivered content and browser behavior.

Actual Safari, assistive technology, operating-system input/autofill and background-window checks remain outside the automated results.

[Documentation](https://acmelabs-15.github.io/design-system/) · [Release evidence](https://github.com/acmelabs-15/design-system/blob/main/notes/alignment/release-0.3.2.md)

**This coordinated release is incomplete. Use [stable 0.3.2](https://github.com/acmelabs-15/design-system/releases/tag/v0.3.2).**

React, MCP and Devtools 0.3.0 were published. npm rejected the 0.3.0 core archive with E415 because it contained too many files. The tag and signed archives remain unchanged as evidence. Version 0.3.2 completes all five package publications and verified public documentation delivery.

The changes below describe the verified 0.3.0 candidate.

### Added

- Generated React wrappers for the Lit component library.
- A documentation MCP package and versioned consumer skills.
- Optional design-system Devtools.
- Selective component registration, scoped registration and CDN module delivery.

### Changed

- Components use consistent names, slots, properties and events.
- Shared primitives own state, themes, form behavior, selection indicators and interaction lifetimes.
- CSS compiles into generated Lit style modules.
- Documentation and examples derive from the same release metadata as the packages.

### Verification

The release requires the complete Linux quality workflow, archive-integrity checks and signed provenance. Browser acceptance covers Chromium, Firefox and WebKit, installed package consumers, React wrappers, scoped registration and documentation.

Actual Safari, assistive technology, operating-system input/autofill and background-window checks remain outside the automated results. The release record preserves these limits.

[Historical release evidence](https://github.com/acmelabs-15/design-system/blob/main/notes/alignment/release-0.3.0.md)

githubReleases.body: Homepage on npm now points at the docs site, https://acmelabs-15.github.io/design-system/. First release published through GitHub Actions with npm's Trusted Publisher (OpenID Connect, provenance attached). No element changes.

The first release of the house design system as Lit web components: 130 `acme-*` elements, one directory per element, shadow DOM with one shared global stylesheet, Geist values throughout, Google Sans Flex and Google Sans Code.

- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@acmelabs/design-system
- Docs: https://acmelabs-15.github.io/design-system/
- CDN, two tags: `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@acmelabs/design-system@0.1/tokens.css` and `…@0.1/dist/bundle/design-system.min.js`
- One tag for hosts that block stylesheet links: `…@0.1/dist/bundle/design-system.standalone.min.js`

Built with a pure-Bun toolchain: the Lit template compiler at build, Bun's bundler for the CDN bundles, `bun:test` with happy-dom, Biome. Labs packages in use: signals, motion, virtualizer, router (the docs app), compiler.
